is [FL IV]L HE ; is P[A-X PV]-BLICA

Copper Alloy nummus of Empress Helena (AD 250-330), mother of Constantine. PAX PVBLICA reverse type. Trier mint, struck c. AD 337-340. See RIC VIII 90, LRBC 128 (pg 6). Obverse depicts diademed female bust facing right. Legend is [FL IV]L HE - LENAE AV[G]. Obverse shows Pax standing left, holding brance and transverse sceptre. Legend is P[A-X PV]-BLICA.
